title: knee-deep in the city that never sleeps

relationships: Harry Du Bois & Kim Kitsuragi & Jean Vicquemare
additional: Written in the Style of the Game Disco Elysium

summary:
KIM KITSURAGI — "You've been out here for ages," he says. He holds a bottle out to you. "You'll get sunburn."
LOGIC — He's right. You didn't bother with sun protection before coming up here, and you're in a short-sleeved shirt with the bare minimum buttons done up, and really very short shorts.
SAVOIR FAIRE — You look disco as fuck, bratan.
